printed_title: Delhi Electricity Regulatory Commission (Group Net Metering and Virtual Net Metering for Renewable Energy) Guidelines, 2019

candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: The capacity of the Renewable Energy System under Group Net Metering or Virtual Net Metering framework to be installed by any Renewable Energy Generator shall not be less than 5 kilo Watt and more than 5000 kilo Watt.
candidate_clauses.topic: GNM/VNM capacity band 5 kW to 5000 kW (original)
